lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical line segments traversing the grey torso; spacing is wider in the anterior region and becomes progressively narrower and more irregular towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 6th vertical stripe (counting from anterior), splitting in the upper dorsal third of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Stripes 1, 2, 10, and 11 exhibit significant discontinuities; specifically, stripe 11 terminates mid-flank, while stripe 12 is reduced to a series of three abbreviated vertical dashes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, positioned above the hock in a loose trapezoidal formation.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the posterior thigh align to form a semi-linear horizontal vector approximately parallel to the ventral line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory with a 65-degree upward vector from the skull, a lateral outward spiral in the medial section, and an inward vertical convergence at the terminals.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal horn tips is approximately 1.4 times the width of the horn base segment.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping constitutes approximately 15 percent of the total vertical horn height.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white dorsal crest is visible from the neck to the rump; distinct white chevrons are present between the eyes, and two white patches are located on the throat and lower neck.
